cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Sandra, I seem to remember you had some family visitors staying with you recently.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yeah, that's right. My brother and his family were here a couple of months ago.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: OK, good. Well, I wanted to ask for your advice.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I got my cousin and her family visiting next month and as I don't have kids, I've no idea

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: where to take them.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Right. What about accommodation? Are they going to stay with you in your flat?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: No, thankfully. There wouldn't be room. My cousin wants me to recommend a hotel.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Do you know anywhere?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yes, I do actually. I always recommend people stay at the King's Hotel.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's about a five minutes walk from Murray Station, so nice and central.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's actually on George Street.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I think they're on quite a tight budget, so how much roughly is it to stay there?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: If you book a family room, it's about £125 per night.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: My brother paid for two double rooms in the end, and I think that was around £95 for each

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: room.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Twelve and nine. So I want to organise some trips while they're here.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I was thinking of doing a bus tour of the city centre, as none of them have been here

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: before.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Those bus tours are quite expensive. I think it's better to do a walking tour.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It gives you a much better feel for the city. There's one that starts from Colton Square.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It takes a couple of hours and doesn't cost that much.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: If the weather's nice, one thing you could do is visit the old fort.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: You could get there by boat. The whole trip takes half a day.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That's a really good idea. I'd like to do that myself.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And if the weather's bad I was thinking they could go to the science museum.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: But maybe they could do that when I'm at work.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: They're here from Saturday for four nights so Tuesday would be best I think.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And it won't be so crowded then. Saturdays are terrible.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I took my kids to the exhibition on old computers there and it was far too crowded.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I wanted to go back but it's finished now.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That's a shame. My cousin's kids would have enjoyed that.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: There's another one starting soon on space, which looks really good too.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Have you thought about where to take them to eat?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well, I really like all the food stalls at Clacton Market. My cousin's vegetarian.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I know it's one of the best places for that kind of food.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Definitely, and there'll be loads of choices for the kids too.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: You need to get there quite early, though.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: At the weekend, most of the stores stop serving lunch at 2.30.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Good point. It's all going to need careful planning.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: My cousin said she'd love to take the kids to a show at the theatre, but tickets are so

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: expensive.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I know.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: But you can get some good deals if you book online with bargained tickets for the

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: following day. On some seats there's a 75% discount.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yeah. There are lots of things you can do for free as well. No need to spend a fortune.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: They're coming next month, right?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well, check and see if it's the same weekend as the Roots Music Festival in Blakewell

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Gardens.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Yeah, check it out online.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's always a family-friendly event and there's no entry charge.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And if you're in Blakewell Gardens, climb Telegraph Hill.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: You'll be able to look right down on the port.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Everyone's always really impressed because it's so huge.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh yeah, I've been meaning to do that for ages. I've heard the view's amazing.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well, that's given me loads of ideas. Thanks so much.
